CHAPTER.VERS:
Now the Ruach HaKodesh says befeirush and in no uncertain terms that in the acharit hayamim some will become meshummad
apostate from the emunah [of Moshiach], giving heed to deceitful ruchot
spirits and teachings of shedim,

through the tzevi'ut
hypocrisy of ones [morim] speaking sheker, the matzpun of whom is seared as with a branding iron.

Such will forbid nisu'im
marriage , commanding hinnazerut
abstinence from that which Hashem created for partaking with todah by the ma'aminim in Moshiach and by the ones who know haEmes,

because the whole Bri'ah
Creation that Hashem has created is tov [Bereshis 1:4,10,12,18,21,25,31] and nothing is to be rejected that is received with todah.
For it is being set apart as kadosh through the dvar Hashem and tefillos and berachot. A GOOD K'LI KODESH OF MOSHIACH

By presenting these things to the achim [in Moshiach] you will be a good k'li kodesh
minister of Moshiach Yehoshua, you will be one nourished with the divrei haEmunah and the torah yeshara
straight teaching which you have followed.

But the worldly aggadot and bubbemeises
old wives tales , refuse. Rather, train yourself [1:4] for chassidus [in Moshiach].

For hitammelut
bodily exercise is kedai
profitable a bissle, but chassidus [in Moshiach] is profitable in every way, holding havtachah
promise of Chayyim now in Olam Hazeh, and, later, of Olam Habah.
The dvar Emes is trustworthy and worthy of all acceptance.

For to this end we labor and strive at the melocha
task , because we have set tikvateynu in the EL CHAI [Yehoshua 3:10] who is Moshi'a
Savior of kol Bnei Adam, that is, the ma'aminim [in Moshiach].

Let no one despise your youth, but become a mofet
example for the ma'aminim [in Moshiach] in loshon
speech , in hitnahagut
conduct , in ahavah, in emunah, and in lev tahor.

Until I come, attend to the keri'ah betzibbur
congregational public reading of the Kitvei Hakodesh, attend to the hattafah
preaching and to the hora'ah
teaching .

Do not neglect the mattanah
gift in you which was given to you by means of nevu'ah
prophecy with the s'michah administered by the Ziknei haKehillah.

Put these things into practice, that your progress in shomer masoret
religious devotion may be manifest to all.

Be shomer both toward yourself and toward your hora'ah, and be arain getun
engrossed, torud [completely absorbed and involved] in this, for, by so doing, you will come to Yeshu'at Eloheynu, and this means not only you yourself but also those who hear your hattafah [about Moshiach].
